name: Unbounce AI
tagline: Unbounce is a landing page builder with powerful AI features including a copy generator, Smart Traffic (which automatically routes visitors to the variant most likely to convert), and AI-powered recommendations for improving conversion rates. It integrates with HubSpot, Mailchimp, and Salesforce.
